items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I think that must have been the same time that Papa Celestan and Bebe Ridgely recorded.

ctx.x: Well, they were coming around. They were picking up bands in different locales, different cities. And at that time, my band wasn't the only one that recorded for OK. They made up bands all around New Orleans. Johnny Detroit and Paul and all of them, they made a record with OK then. That was in 1923. I do remember that. I think Johnny made Tulane Swing.
I think that must have been the same time that Papa Celestan and Bebe Ridgely recorded. Just about. They made a record.
They may have made a record then. I didn't think so, but they may have.
